verdict.rationale: Tailscale's WireGuard-based mesh gives devices stable, fixed tailnet IPs and 'always on' connectivity, and user testimonials show SSH sessions surviving travel/network changes (docs-18, docs-19, docs-7), but one testimonial itself notes needing to 'restart the process' after network change (docs-17), and community reports describe real NAT-traversal hiccups and DERP fallback limiting seamless reconnection (tailscale-comm-8, tailscale-comm-10). There's no explicit first-party claim or feature dedicated to keeping an active terminal session (e.g., SSH/mosh-style) alive through sleep/reconnect—only general network-layer persistence. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of session-level persistence across device sleep, and confirmation the underlying tunnel reconnect is seamless enough to avoid SSH session drops in all cases.
